title: FEC Campaign Finance - Super PAC, Candidates & Donors Search
description: Campaign finance data via the official FEC open.fec.gov API: search US federal candidates by name/state/office/party/cycle with totals, donor and campaign contributions (Schedule A), committee spending (Schedule B) or independent expenditures for/against candidates (Schedule E). No key needed.
seoTitle: FEC Scraper, Campaign Finance API, Political Donor Data API
seoDescription: Election data API and campaign spending API over official FEC filings: political campaign data, federal candidates data, candidate finance data, donor search API, plus political data API.

result.eventDescription: One result row: a candidate record (with financial totals if requested), a donor contribution, a committee disbursement, or an independent expenditure.
